nodes.text: Ohhhhhh, Masato. I thought you said gelato. Yeah, I know that skinny motherfucker. Just like him to send a scrawny rat from the sewers to intimidate lil ol' me. What, the Twins busy or something?

nodes.text: Alright, look, I don't have the Lims, okay? I got scraped out clean by this express line that ran three minutes ahead of schedule. Three minutes! CorpSec was rippin' at that kind of efficient service.
